Hi Kevin / Sarah — attaching the items you requested. See notes below.

Attachments (stubs):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report for period Jan 1, 2025 — Dec 31, 2025)
- SOC2_bridge_letter_draft.docx (draft bridge letter referencing no material changes to controls since the 2025 report; editable)
- Acme_Security_Q_v1_filled.xlsx (initial pass on your questionnaire; see open items flagged in column H)

Trust portal invite:
- Invite link: https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/ACME-123/invite
- Access: use security@acme.com and procurement@acme.com. The invite grants read-only reviewer access to the evidence folders for SOC 2 in our portal; individual reviewer SSO is supported. The invite expires in 14 days by default — we can extend if needed.

GDPR / HIPAA summary (high level):
- GDPR: Redwood processes customer data as a data processor; data residency options available per region. Our DPA and standard contractual clauses can be provided.
- HIPAA: Redwood offers a HIPAA baseline for customers who sign a BAA; our inference paths can be configured to avoid PHI persistence. For Acme specifically, we do not store PHI by default unless configured; please confirm if any of your payloads contain PHI.

Next steps from our side:
1) Please review the attached bridge letter draft and let us know any edits; we can obtain a signed, on-company-letterhead version if required (timeline ~3 business days once finalized).
2) Review the questionnaire; items flagged with comments need SE/engineering input — Dev will take point on those.
3) Use the trust portal invite link to onboard reviewers; reach out if you need extended access or API exports.

If you prefer, we can schedule a short follow-up with our security team to walk through any questions.

Best — Aditya
